RAJYA  SABHA
————
List of Questions for ORAL ANSWERS
to be asked at a sitting of the Rajya Sabha to be held on
Friday, the May 19, 2006/Vaisakha 29, 1928 (Saka)
————
(Ministries : Agriculture; Agro and Rural Industries; Chemicals and
Fertilizers; Consumer Affairs, Food and Public Distribution;
Environment and Forests; Health and Family Welfare;
Railways; Small Scale Industries; Steel)
Total number of questions —20
Survey of Nasirabad-Bundi railway
line
†*501. SHRI GIREESH KUMAR
SANGHI:
DR. PRABHA THAKUR:
Will the Minister of RAILWAYS be
pleased to state:
(a) whether a provision was made in
the last budget for the survey of Nasirabad-
Bundi railway line in Rajasthan;
(b) if so, whether Government have
completed that survey; and
(c) the work proposed to be done further
by Government and the details thereof?
Ban on retail sale of bird flu drugs
*502. SHRI TARIQ ANWAR: Will the
Minister of HEALTH AND FAMILY
WELFARE be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that approval has
been sent to ban the retail sale of bird flu
drugs; and
(b) if so, the details thereof and the
reasons therefor?
Medicines prescribed/disbursed by
C.G.H.S. dispensaries
*503. SHRIMATI MOHSINA
KIDWAI: Will the Minister of HEALTH
AND FAMILY WELFARE be pleased to
state:
(a) the list/names/details of the
medicines that can be prescribed/disbursed
directly by the MO/CMO of C.G.H.S.
dispensaries;
(b) the proportion of such medicines
disposed as compared to medicines
disbursed through indent procedure on
recommendation of Specialists, in terms of
their cost value (latest available figures);
(c) whether it is a fact that the activity
of diagnosis and treatment has concentrated
with the Specialists and the dispensaries
are just centers for disbursement of
medicines; and
(d) the remedial steps proposed, if any,
to restore the real utility of the dispensaries?
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

156
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
National River Conservation Plan
*504. SHRI ABU ASIM AZMI: Will
the Minister of ENVIRONMENT AND
FORESTS be pleased to state:
(a) whether the National River
Conservation Plan is under implementation
in the country;
(b) if so, the total funds released by
Government, so far, under this plan utilized
by the concerned State-Governments;
(c) how far the scheme has been
completed most particularly the Ganga and
Yamuna Action Plan; and
(d) by when the plan is expected to be
completed?
Frame work for implementation of
NRHM
†*505. SHRI BHAGWATI SINGH:
Will the Minister of HEALTH AND
FAMILY WELFARE be pleased to state:
(a) the feature of the National Rural
Health Mission and framework for
implementation of this scheme;
(b) the details of allocation of 8,207
crore rupees given in the budget for this
year 2006-07 item-wise;
(c) the details of role and training of the
workers 'Asha';
(d) whether Government think that this
programme would take us to success in
achieving the target of health for all; and
(e) if so, the details of the strategy to be
adopted to achieve the same?
Announcement of bonus in addition to
support price for wheat
†*506. SHRI MOTILAL VORA:
MS. SUSHILA TIRIYA:
Will the Minister of CONSUMER
AFFAIRS, FOOD AND PUBLIC
DISTRIBUTION be pleased to state:
(a) the support price of wheat fixed by
Government for 2006-07;
(b) whether Government have also
announced to give a bonus of Rs. 50/- per
quintal in addition to the support price;
(c) whether prices of wheat in the retail
market have gone high due to purchases
made by the MNCs and local stockists as
per announcement of the bonus of Rs. 50/
- per quintal;
(d) whether the given bonus has caused
a rise in the prices; and
(e) whether Government would succeed
in getting wheat for buffer stock after the
large scale purchase of wheat by MNCs
and local stockists?
Assistance for oil palm development
in Karnataka
*507. SHRIMATI PREMA
CARIAPPA: Will the Minister of
AGRICULTURE be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have released
the amount for oil palm development during
2005 and 2006 for Karnataka;
(b) if so, the details of share of Central
and State Government; and
(c) the details of total amount released
till today?

157
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
Crop diversification programme
*508. SHRI MANOHAR GAJANAN
JOSHI: Will the Minister of
AGRICULTURE be pleased to state:
(a) whether a plan has been formulated
to improve soil and launch a new crop
diversification programme;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) the States where it is proposed to be
launched?
Backlog vacancies
*509. SHRI PRAVEEN
RASHTRAPAL: Will the Minister of
RAILWAYS be pleased to state:
(a) the number of backlog vacancies as
on 31st March 2004 in his Ministry and
various departments under his Ministry
(b) whether, special drive was carried
out to fill the above backlog vacancies;
(c) if so, the number of vacancies filled
during the last two years, department-wise;
and
(d) what is the backlog vacancies as on
31st March 2006?

RAJYA  SABHA
————
List of Questions for WRITTEN ANSWERS
to be asked at a sitting of the Rajya Sabha to be held on
Friday,  the May 19, 2006/Vaisakha 29, 1928 (Saka)
————
(Ministries: Agriculture; Agro and Rural Industries; Chemicals and Fertilizers;
Consumer Affairs, Food and Public Distribution; Environment and Forests;
Health and Family Welfare; Railways; Small Scale Industries; Steel)
Total number of questions — 155
Farmers trained by CTRI
3641. SHRI V. HANUMANTHA
RAO: Will the Minister of
AGRICULTURE be pleased to state:
(a) the number of farmers trained by
Central Tobacco Research Institute during
the last year;
(b) whether CTRI has given any
importance to training of farmers of Andhra
Pradesh;
(c) whether it is a fact that the CTRI
has not given sufficient importance to
extending the full benefits or research in
tobacco to middle level tobacco farmers in
Andhra Pradesh;
(d) the steps proposed by Government
to assist farmers through the CTRI in
 2006-07; and
(e) the reasons for low emphasis on this
matter?
Claim of bonus by workers of
Sugarcane Breeding Institute,
Coimbatore
3642. SHRI MOINUL HASSAN
AHAMED: Will the Minister of
AGRICULTURE be pleased to state:
(a) whether the Industrial Tribunal at
Chennai had passed an award on the dispute
relating to claim of bonus by the workers
of the Sugarcane Breeding Institute at
Coimbatore, Tamil Nadu;
(b) whether it is a fact that the same
award has covered the demand for
regularization in service of the workforce
of the same institute; and
(c) if so, the action initiated by
Government to implement the said award?
Increasing fertilizer consumption
3643. SHRI T.T.V. DHINAKARAN:
Will the Minister of AGRICULTURE be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the per hectare
consumption of chemical fertilizers in the
country is less than 90 kg.;
(b) the reasons for such low rate of
fertilizer consumption;
(c) the steps taken to increase fertilizer
application to increase productivity; and
(d) the steps taken by Government to
promote new farming practices to increase
yield?

826
Senior official on deep-sea tuna boats
3644. SHRI V. HANUMANTHA
RAO: Will the Minister of
AGRICULTURE be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Government
have cleared proposals to post one senior
official on every deep-sea tuna boat
operating in our waters in the EEZ;
(b) the purpose of this new rule being
considered by Government;
(c) whether Government want to give
training and experience to senior officials
involved in policy formulation;
(d) the details of such hands-on-training
being proposed;
(e) the minimum rank of officials who
will go on board for such mandatory training
on tuna boats to experience for themselves
with the realities of fishing and how to make
policy practical; and
(f) the schedule for such activity in the
next two months?
Use of pesticides and insecticides in
farming
3645. SHRI JANARDHANA
POOJARY: Will the Minister of
AGRICULTURE be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that pesticides
and other insecticides are freely used in
vegetable farming;
(b) whether human beings and animals
consuming such vegetables face grave health
hazards;
(c) if so, the details in this regard; and
(d) the details of the measures taken/
proposed to be taken by Government to
eliminate use of pesticides in vegetable
farming?
Assistance for cultivation of Jatropha
in Chhattisgarh
3646. SHRIMATI MOHSINA
KIDWAI: Will the Minister of
AGRICULTURE be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Planning
Commission has approved on over
Rs. 1200 crores demonstration project for
the cultivation of Jatropha;
(b) how much amount has been
proposed to be allocated to Chhattisgarh
and how much area in this State has been in
use for Jatropha plantation; and
(c) what special incentives have been
provided to Chhattisgarh by the National
Mission on Bio-diesel?
Authority for development of rainfed
areas
3647. SHRIMATI S.G. INDIRA:
DR. M.A.M. RAMASWAMY:
Will the Minister of AGRICUL TURE
be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Government
are considering to set up a national
authority for sustainable development of
rainfed areas;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether Government had received
any recommendations in this regard; and
(d) if so, the details thereof?
Assistance to States for establishing
agriculture research centres
3648. SHRI SHANT ARAM
LAXMAN NAIK: Will the Minister of
AGRICULTURE be pleased to state:
(a) whether there is any scheme to give
financial assistance to establish State-level

827
agriculture research centres to the State
Governments;
(b) if so, the name of the scheme and its
essential features;
(c) the names of the States who have
sought financial and other assistance in this
regard; and
(d) the States to whom assistance, if
any has been granted?
Bio-diesel production
3649. SHRIMATI VIPLOVE
